8A.6.eg: Loading computer Class approved, test conditions run regularly (every 3 months / per SMS).
ex: Loading computer approved by Class and regular accuracy tests.
8A.6.fg: Class approved ang loading computer, regular ang test conditions (bawat 3 buwan / ayon sa SMS).
fc: Class approval ng loading software (cert/version)
Periodic accuracy test kumpara sa approved test conditions – may records
Annual class verification
fx: Aprubado ng Class ang loading computer at may regular na accuracy test.
ff: Hindi na-run ang loading computer test conditions sa takdang interval

8A.7.eg: Stress & stability monitored through the loading, draft checks, ballast in sync.
ex: Officers know the stresses and stability of the cargo plan and monitor them through the whole loading.
Checks cargo and ballast go together and draft checks are done in between
Drafts must agree with the calculation
8A.7.fg: Binabantayan ang stress at stability sa buong loading, draft checks, sabay ang ballast.
fc: Loading plan na may SF/BM sa bawat step; aktuwal na readings habang may ops
Draft checks sa intermediate steps kumpara sa computer
Sabay ang ballast sa loading
fx: Alam ng officers ang stresses at stability ng cargo plan at binabantayan ito sa buong loading.
Chine-check kung sabay ang cargo at ballast at may draft checks sa gitna
Dapat tugma ang drafts sa computation

fc: Procedure sa paggamit ng ballast hold; blank flanges/bilge isolation
fx: May procedures para sa ballast holds.

8A.9.fg: Instructions sa hold cleaning pagkatapos mag-discharge.
fc: Hold cleaning procedure at records; naka-record ang pagtapon ng washing water
fx: May instructions para sa hold cleaning.

8A.10.eg: Know the loading manual restrictions (e.g. alternate holds, BC-A/B/C).
ex: No restrictions from the Loading Manual or Stability Booklet.
Writes the important restrictions in the comments
8A.10.fg: Alamin ang restrictions ng loading manual (hal. alternate holds, BC-A/B/C).
fc: Alamin ang restrictions ng loading manual (BC-A/B/C, empty holds, max draft)
Itinatala ito ng inspector – maging eksakto
fx: Walang restriction mula sa Loading Manual o Stability Booklet.
Isinusulat ang mahahalagang restriction sa comments

8A.11.eg: Officers know the cargo hazards/requirements (IMSBC schedule).
ex: Officers know the hazards of the cargo.
8A.11.fg: Alam ng officers ang panganib/requirements ng cargo (IMSBC schedule).
fc: Naka-print at napag-usapan ang IMSBC schedule ng kasalukuyang cargo
Kayang ipaliwanag ng officers ang panganib (liquefaction, self-heating, O2 depletion)
fx: Alam ng officers ang panganib ng cargo.

8A.12.eg: Measures against liquefaction/chemical reaction, and they are followed.
ex: Measures against liquefaction and chemical reaction.
8A.12.fg: May hakbang laban sa liquefaction/chemical reaction, at sinusunod.
fc: Procedures para sa Group A cargoes: can test, trimming, bilge monitoring
Records ng checks habang naglalayag
fx: May hakbang laban sa liquefaction at chemical reaction.

8A.13.eg: For cargo not in IMSBC: provisional certificate from the competent authority.
ex: For a cargo not listed in IMSBC: a certificate from the competent authority.
8A.13.fg: Para sa cargo na wala sa IMSBC: provisional certificate mula sa competent authority.
fc: Tripartite agreement / competent authority certificate kung hindi listed
fx: Para sa cargo na wala sa IMSBC: certificate mula sa competent authority.

8A.14.eg: Loading/unloading plan with cargo & ballast sequence, signed by all.
ex: Loading/unloading plan with cargo and ballast sequence, signed by the Master and officers.
8A.14.fg: Loading/unloading plan na may sequence ng cargo at ballast, may pirma ng lahat.
fc: Plan na may pours, ballast steps, stresses – may pirma ng Master at lahat ng deck officers
Napagkasunduan sa terminal (BLU Code)
fx: Loading/unloading plan na may sequence ng cargo at ballast, may pirma ng Master at officers.
ff: Walang pirma ng terminal ang loading plan / walang ballast sequence

8A.15.fg: Cargo log na may lahat ng aktibidad.
fc: Cargo log: start/stop, pours, delays, drafts, ballast
fx: Records ng lahat ng cargo operations.

8A.16.eg: Records of cargo care during the voyage (hold checks, ventilation, bilges).
ex: Records of cargo care during the voyage.
Checks hold inspections with time, findings and actions
8A.16.fg: Records ng pag-aalaga ng cargo habang naglalayag (hold checks, ventilation, bilges).
fc: Voyage cargo care log: hold inspections na may oras, bilge soundings, ventilation, temperatura
Naka-record ang aksyon sa findings
fx: Records ng pag-aalaga ng cargo habang naglalayag.
Chine-check ang hold inspections na may oras, findings at aksyon

8A.17.eg: O2 depletion risk: hold entry procedure, readings before entry.
ex: Crew know the risk of lack of O2 and take precautions.
8A.17.fg: Panganib ng O2 depletion: hold entry procedure, readings bago pumasok.
fc: Pagpasok sa hold at katabing space (forecastle store, ladder trunks) na may gas test
May warning signs sa access hatches
fx: Alam ng crew ang panganib ng kulang na O2 at gumagawa ng pag-iingat.

8A.18.eg: Coal: temperature instruments, CH4/O2/CO/H2S, bilge pH – calibrated, with records.
ex: For coal: temperature, gas and pH instruments maintained, with records.
8A.18.fg: Coal: temperature instruments, CH4/O2/CO/H2S, bilge pH – calibrated at may records.
fc: Temperature probes, multi-gas meter (CH4/O2/CO/H2S), pH kit – calibrated
Coal monitoring records (headspace gas araw-araw)
fx: Para sa coal: naaalagaan ang instruments sa temperatura, gas at pH, may records.

8A.19.eg: Special IMSBC equipment (e.g. for DG cargo) ready.
8A.19.fg: Handa ang special IMSBC equipment (hal. para sa DG cargo).
fc: Special equipment ayon sa IMSBC schedule (gas meters, protective clothing)
May EmS para sa DG cargoes

8B.2.eg: Grain cargo information before loading (SF etc.).
8B.2.fg: Grain cargo information bago magkarga (SF atbp.).
fc: Shipper's declaration kasama ang stowage factor
fx: May impormasyon sa grain bago magkarga.

8B.4.eg: Document of Authorisation & Grain Loading Manual approved.
ex: Document of Authorisation and Grain Loading Manual.
8B.4.fg: Aprubado ang Document of Authorisation at Grain Loading Manual.
fc: DoA (Grain) nasa barko at valid para sa barko
Aprubadong grain stability booklet
fx: Document of Authorisation at Grain Loading Manual.

8B.5.eg: If no DoA – proof of compliance with the Grain Code.
ex: If there is no DoA, the Master proves compliance with the Grain Code.
8B.5.fg: Kung walang DoA – patunay na sumusunod sa Grain Code.
fc: Kayang ipakita ng Master ang Grain Code calc (heeling moments, criteria)
fx: Kung walang DoA, papatunayan ng Master na sumusunod sa Grain Code.

8B.6.eg: Loading computer with grain module, approved, tested.
8B.6.fg: Loading computer na may grain module, aprubado, nasubukan.
fc: Class-approved ang grain module; periodic test records
fx: Aprubado ang loading computer, may test.

8B.7.eg: Stress & stability monitored throughout grain loading.
ex: Monitoring of stresses and stability through the whole loading.
8B.7.fg: Binabantayan ang stress at stability sa buong grain loading.
fc: Na-compute at binabantayan ang bawat stage; draft checks
fx: Pagbabantay ng stresses at stability sa buong loading.

fc: Gaya ng 8A.8
fx: May procedures para sa ballast holds.

fc: Procedure at records
fx: May procedures para sa hold cleaning.

8B.10.eg: Holds grain clean, third-party hold inspection certificate.
ex: Holds grain or hospital clean, with a third-party hold inspection certificate before loading.
8B.10.fg: Grain clean ang holds, may third-party hold inspection certificate.
fc: Grain-clean ang holds: walang rust scale, lumang cargo, natuklap na pintura, insekto
Hold inspection certificate (surveyor/NCB/USDA) ng huling grain loading
fx: Grain o hospital clean ang holds, may hold inspection certificate mula sa third party bago magkarga.

8B.11.eg: Know the loading manual / grain booklet restrictions.
ex: No restrictions from the Loading Manual.
8B.11.fg: Alamin ang restrictions ng loading manual / grain booklet.
fc: Alamin ang restrictions at rules sa partly-filled hold
fx: Walang restriction mula sa Loading Manual.

8B.12.eg: Know grain hazards (shifting, heating, fumigation, O2).
ex: Officers know the hazards of grain.
8B.12.fg: Alamin ang panganib ng grain (shifting, heating, fumigation, O2).
fc: Kayang ipaliwanag ng officers ang panganib ng grain
fx: Alam ng officers ang panganib ng grain.

8B.13.eg: Ultrasonic test of hatch covers before grain loading.
ex: Ultrasonic test of the hatch covers before loading.
8B.13.fg: Ultrasonic test ng hatch covers bago mag-grain loading.
fc: UT test report (third party/certified crew) bago magkarga, pasado lahat ng panel
fx: Ultrasonic test ng hatch covers bago magkarga.

8B.14.eg: Fumigation instructions to the Master before arriving at the load port.
ex: Fumigation instructions to the Master before the loading port.
8B.14.fg: Fumigation instructions sa Master bago dumating sa load port.
fc: Nakasulat na fumigation instructions (fumigant, paraan, pag-iingat)
fx: Fumigation instructions sa Master bago ang loading port.

8B.15.eg: Fumigation procedures/contingencies; Master & C/O know them.
ex: Fumigation procedures, and the Master/C/O know them.
8B.15.fg: Fumigation procedures/contingencies; alam ng Master at C/O.
fc: Company fumigation procedure; pamilyar ang Master/C/O
fx: May fumigation procedures, at alam ito ng Master/C/O.

8B.16.eg: Crew know the hazards of fumigation.
ex: Crew know the hazards of fumigation.
8B.16.fg: Alam ng crew ang panganib ng fumigation.
fc: Crew briefing records sa panganib ng phosphine
fx: Alam ng crew ang panganib ng fumigation.

8B.17.eg: Fumigation safety requirements (IMO MSC.1/Circ.1264) – gas detectors, BA, first aid.
ex: Fumigation safety measures as per IMO recommendation 3.3.2.7.
8B.17.fg: Fumigation safety requirements (IMO MSC.1/Circ.1264) – gas detectors, BA, first aid.
fc: Phosphine detection tubes/meters (calibrated) + BA
First aid at MFAG; antidote info
fx: Safety measures sa fumigation ayon sa IMO recommendation 3.3.2.7.

8B.18.eg: Trained Master's representatives for fumigation, with records.
ex: Trained representatives of the Master for fumigation.
8B.18.fg: Trained na representative ng Master para sa fumigation, may records.
fc: Training ng appointed persons; gas reading records
fx: Trained na representative ng Master para sa fumigation.
